'''Architect's Hollow''' was a cave on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. At the time of the [[Galactic War]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Marka Ragnos]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who lived during the reign of the first [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], haunted the cave.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Architect's Hollow appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
